The Bard.description: An artist through and through, with ambitions far beyond merely pleasing an audience
The Bard.level1Help: At Level 1 your max hp is 8 and your cha is +2. Choose dex or int to be +1, then assign +1, 0, and -1 to the others.

default-gear.title: Choose a weapon (or create a new one with the GM):

options.name: decorated long sword + buckler
options.details: 1d8 dmg #hand. Mark to ignore half dmg (rounded down) from one attack

options.name: adventuring gear
options.details: Mark to rummage through and find a useful mundane item

options.name: artistic samples
options.details: Mark once to share with an NPC while you Sense Motive to roll with adv

options.name: bag of books
options.details: Mark to find a record of relevant information

options.name: fine delicacies
options.details: Mark while you Make Camp to recover all hp. You can share with any number of PCs. Everyone who eats gets the benefit

options.name: provisions
options.details: Mark once while you Comfort or Support to turn a "No" into a "Yes"

The Cleric.description: No mere priest, a divine emissary armed with steel and powers from above

default-gear.title: Choose a blunt weapon (or create a new one with the GM):

options.name: consecrated mace
options.details: 1d6 dmg #hand + shield. Mark to ignore all dmg from one attack

options.name: reinforced net
options.details: 0 dmg #close #hand. Mark to trap one medium or some small creatures under it

options.name: holy water vials
options.details: #holy #close. Mark to ignore all Resistances of an enemy of your deity until the end of the Scene

options.name: leather armor
options.details: dmg reduction 1 (reduces all incoming dmg by 1, to a min of 1). Min STR+1 to use properly

options.name: medicine
options.details: Mark to have someone double the HP they recover next or clear one Condition/affliction

options.name: pious supplies
options.details: Mark to rummage through and find an item used in your deity's worship, such as candles, censer, incense, or holy vestments

options.name: provisions
options.details: Mark once while you Comfort or Support to turn a "No" into a "Yes"
